name: nextcloud/byebyemoneylist
description:
Bye‑Bye Money List is an AI‑powered shopping list manager and expense tracker that gives you a clear, structured overview of where your money goes. Scan receipts, organize purchases, track income, and analyze your spending — all in one privacy‑first app.

AI Receipt Scanning
• Snap a photo of any receipt — the app recognizes products, prices, and store info automatically   
• Choose your preferred AI engine: now supported Google Gemini or SiliconFlow (DeepSeek/Qwen)   
• Items are instantly sorted into your custom categories

Your Categories, Your Rules
• Build your own category hierarchy (e.g., Food → Dairy → Cheese)   
• No forced structure — organize your expenses exactly the way you want
• Assign custom colors for clean, readable charts 

Smart Shopping Lists
• Plan your shopping in advance
• Switch to In‑Store Mode and check off items as you go   
• Add purchases directly to your expense history

Personal Product Catalog
• Maintain your own product database   
• Scan barcodes for quick search
• Compare prices across different stores  
• Use barcodes for quick searching and compare prices across different stores.

Advanced Analytics
• View expenses by category, store, or shopping list   
• Analyze pie charts, quantity trends, and price history for every product 

Complete Financial Overview
• Track income sources for a balanced monthly budget view   
• Mark products or lists as subscriptions to monitor recurring costs separately 

Privacy‑First
Your data stays on your device.
No accounts, no ads, no tracking — just your shopping and expenses, organized clearly.
